question: What has each of the five actually disclosed about advisor compensation structures?
reasoning_content:
Let me analyze this sub-question about Edward Jones's advisor compensation structure. I need to extract facts about what Edward Jones has disclosed about its advisor compensation structure.

Let me identify the relevant passages that discuss advisor compensation structure.

Key passage: EDJ-10K-2025#30 - "Financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership."

This is a clear fact about the compensation structure.

EDJ-ADV-2026#65 - "If you purchased investments through Edward Jones as a broker-dealer, you would pay sales charges or commissions, a portion of which would be paid to your financial advisor."

EDJ-ADV-2026#67 - "The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and Reserve Line Advance balances, will impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and bonus amount. The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and client Reserve Line Advance balances may also impact a financial advisors' eligibility for the receipt of certain limited partnership profits interest..."

Also "Most financial advisors are eligible to participate in the Edward Jones Travel Award Program... Eligibility... based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care."

EDJ-10K-2025#264 - "Financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors."

EDJ-10K-2025#334 - service partners of JFC... payments

EDJ-10K-2025#221 - Non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.

EDJ-10K-2025#58 - "a significant portion of their compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability."

EDJ-10Q-2026Q2#75 - variable compensation described.

Let me compile the key facts about advisor compensation structure.

The sub-question is about the compensation structure (not the dollar amounts). So I should focus on how advisors are compensated: commission basis, minimum guaranteed salary, additional compensation based on branch profitability and partnership profitability, bonuses, profits interest, travel award program, deferred compensation plan, etc.

Let me identify each fact item.

1. From EDJ-10K-2025#30: Financial advisors generally compensated on commission basis, subject to minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on branch office profitability and Partnership profitability.

2. From EDJ-ADV-2026#65: advisor earns a portion of sales charges/commissions in brokerage; typically earns more upfront in brokerage, more over time in advisory.

3. From EDJ-ADV-2026#67: Program Fee, assets under care, Reserve Line Advance balances impact bonus eligibility/amount; Profits Interest; Travel Award Program based on assets under care.

4. From EDJ-10K-2025#264: Financial advisor bonuses determined by overall Partnership profitability and individual performance.

5. From EDJ-10K-2025#58: significant portion of compensation variable based on Partnership profitability.

6. From EDJ-10K-2025#221: non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.

7. From EDJ-10K-2025#334: financial advisors who are service partners of JFC.

8. From EDJ-ADV-2026#66: financial advisor may receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on branch profitability.

9. From EDJ-10Q-2026Q2#75: financial advisor compensation and benefits expense increased due to increases in revenues on which commissions are earned. Variable compensation allocated to bonuses and profit sharing.

I'll compile the main facts. Let me focus on the structural disclosure items.

Let me create items.

Item 1: Financial advisors generally compensated on commission basis, subject to minimum guaranteed salary, may be entitled to additional compensation based on branch office profitability and Partnership profitability. (EDJ-10K-2025#30)

Item 2: Advisor earns portion of sales charges/commissions in brokerage; typically earns more upfront in brokerage, more over time in advisory. (EDJ-ADV-2026#65)

Item 3: Program Fee, assets under care, Reserve Line Advance balances impact bonus eligibility and amount; also Profits Interest eligibility. (EDJ-ADV-2026#67)

Item 4: Travel Award Program eligibility based on amount of new and existing assets under care. (EDJ-ADV-2026#67)

Item 5: Financial advisor bonuses determined by overall Partnership profitability and individual performance. (EDJ-10K-2025#264)

Item 6: significant portion of compensation variable based on Partnership profitability. (EDJ-10K-2025#58)

Item 7: Non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors. (EDJ-10K-2025#221)

Item 8: financial advisor may receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on branch profitability. (EDJ-ADV-2026#66)

Item 9: financial advisors who are service partners of JFC, not employees of Edward Jones; payments made. (EDJ-10K-2025#334)

Let me also consider variable compensation item from 10Q - "Variable compensation... paid to associates in the form of bonuses and profit sharing." This describes variable compensation broadly, applies to associates. Could be relevant to advisor compensation. But it's more general. I could include it as a fact about the performance-based model.

Actually, I'll include a couple more but keep focused.

Let me write these items with proper quotes and periods. For structural descriptions, period is "" (not a specific period) and value "".

Let me write them out.

For item 1, quote: "Financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership."

For item 2, quote from #65: "If you purchased investments through Edward Jones as a broker-dealer, you would pay sales charges or commissions, a portion of which would be paid to your financial advisor. A financial advisor will typically earn more in upfront fees and commissions when you use brokerage services. In the alternative, a financial advisor will typically earn more over time if you invest in Advisory Solutions Fund Models."

For item 3, quote from #67: "The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and Reserve Line Advance balances, will impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and bonus amount. The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and client Reserve Line Advance balances may also impact a financial advisors' eligibility for the receipt of certain limited partnership profits interest..."

For item 4, quote: "Most financial advisors are eligible to participate in the Edward Jones Travel Award Program... Eligibility for the Travel Award Program is based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care of a financial advisor..."

For item 5, quote from #264: "Financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors."

For item 6, quote from #58: "a significant portion of their compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability."

For item 7, quote from #221: "The Partnership has a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors."

For item 8, quote from #66: "your financial advisor may also receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of your financial advisor's branch."

For item 9, quote from #334: "has a written agreement with The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P. ("JFC") for the services of certain financial advisors who are service partners of JFC and not employees of Edward Jones."

Good. These are all facts about the compensation structure.

Let me set the label to fact, and derivation empty.

Now write reason: "The passages describe Edward Jones' advisor compensation structure in detail."

Let me finalize the submission.

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones states that financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.
items.quote: Financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.

items.text: Edward Jones states that if a client purchased investments through Edward Jones as a broker-dealer, the client would pay sales charges or commissions, a portion of which would be paid to the financial advisor; a financial advisor will typically earn more in upfront fees and commissions for brokerage services, and typically more over time for Advisory Solutions Fund Models.
items.quote: If you purchased investments through Edward Jones as a broker-dealer, you would pay sales charges or commissions, a portion of which would be paid to your financial advisor. A financial advisor will typically earn more in upfront fees and commissions when you use brokerage services. In the alternative, a financial advisor will typically earn more over time if you invest in Advisory Solutions Fund Models.

items.text: Edward Jones states that the Program Fee, assets under care and Reserve Line Advance balances impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and bonus amount, and may also impact a financial advisor's eligibility for receipt of certain limited partnership profits interest in The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P.
items.quote: The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and Reserve Line Advance balances, will impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and bonus amount. The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and client Reserve Line Advance balances may also impact a financial advisors' eligibility for the receipt of certain limited partnership profits interest in The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P.

items.text: Edward Jones states that most financial advisors are eligible to participate in the Edward Jones Travel Award Program, with eligibility based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care of a financial advisor.
items.quote: Most financial advisors are eligible to participate in the Edward Jones Travel Award Program ("Travel Award Program"), which includes domestic and international travel, or a cash award in lieu of a trip. Eligibility for the Travel Award Program is based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care of a financial advisor.

items.text: Edward Jones states that financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors.
items.quote: Financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors.

items.text: Edward Jones states that a significant portion of financial advisors' compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability.
items.quote: there is increased risk the Partnership's more successful financial advisors may leave because a significant portion of their compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability.

items.text: Edward Jones states that it has a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.
items.quote: The Partnership has a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.

items.text: Edward Jones states that a financial advisor may also receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of the financial advisor's branch.
items.quote: your financial advisor may also receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of your financial advisor's branch.

items.text: Edward Jones states that certain financial advisors are service partners of JFC and not employees of Edward Jones, and that Edward Jones made payments to those service partners on JFC's behalf for the services they provided.
items.quote: Edward D. Jones & Co., L.P. ("Edward Jones"), has a written agreement with The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P. ("JFC") for the services of certain financial advisors who are service partners of JFC and not employees of Edward Jones. Pursuant to the agreement, Edward Jones made payments to the service partners of JFC on JFC's behalf for those services provided.

items.text: Edward Jones states that a significant portion of the Partnership's profits is allocated to variable compensation and paid to associates in the form of bonuses and profit sharing, and that this remains a key component of the Firm's performance-based compensation model.
items.quote: A significant portion of the Partnership's profits is allocated to variable compensation and paid to associates in the form of bonuses and profit sharing and remains a key component of the Firm's performance-based compensation model.

cells.reason: The passages describe in detail how Edward Jones financial advisors are compensated (commission basis, minimum guaranteed salary, branch/Partnership profitability-based bonuses, profits interests, deferred compensation, and travel awards), so these are facts about the advisor compensation structure.
